newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador minister accused of striking woman worker.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador minister accused of striking woman worker.

text.p: Ecuadoran Energy Minister Alfredo Adum faces investigation by an official human rights commission over allegations he struck a woman employee in the face, congressional spokesmen said on Wednesday.

A congressional commission decided to ask the Truth and Justice Commission to examine charges Adum hit Sonia Palacios, a worker with state oil firm Petroecuador, and forced her to resign after accusing her on Tuesday of taking illicit payments.
President Abdala Bucaram set up the Truth and Justice Commission in September to look into human rights abuses since 1979.

Adum has regularly clashed with oil workers over his accusations of corruption. He also provoked outrage among feminist groups over recent remarks to a magazine that he would like to live naked and prey on women like a caveman.
